Thick_Oak_Branch_Arms.description: Brawny and resilient, the Thick Oak Branch Arms are a fusion of raw strength and natural fortitude, with bark-hardened skin and sinewy fibers that grant their bearer unparalleled defensive capabilities and the ability to cleave through foes with ease.

Whipping_Willow_Vine_Arms.description: Sinuous and prehensile, the Whipping Willow Vine Arms are a deadly appendage of twisted flora, capable of agile movements and powerful slashes, granting their bearer an unparalleled reach and dexterity as they swing and climb with unnatural grace.

Thorny_Briar_Tangle_Arms.description: Enveloped in an ever-twisting lattice of razor-sharp thorns, the Thorny Briar Tangle Arms are fearsome plant-based appendages that enhance their wielder's physical might and defensive capabilities, while granting them the ability to grapple and inflict grievous bleeding wounds upon their foes.

Prehensile_Kelp_Frond_Arms.description: Emerging from the depths of the ocean, the Prehensile_Kelp_Frond_Arms are a marvel of aquatic adaptation, their sinuous, leafy tendrils capable of both delicate manipulation and powerful grappling, enhancing agility and evasion as they weave through the water with unmatched grace and speed.

Carnivorous_Flytrap_Graspers.description: Emerging from the twisted, vine-wrapped limbs of this carnivorous plant are thick, muscular grasping tendrils, each tipped with sharp, serrated edges and a powerful bite, capable of snaring and crushing prey with ruthless efficiency.

Petrified_Wood_Smashing_Arms.description: Enormous, petrified limbs forged from ancient, twisted wood, these arms are both a shield and a weapon, their sheer mass granting incredible strength and durability, yet their cumbersome nature slightly hinders agility.

Bioluminescent_Fungal_Stalk_Arms.description: Twisting from the ground like ethereal serpents, the bioluminescent fungal stalk arms are living conduits of arcane wisdom, their pulsating glow casting eerie patterns that reveal hidden paths through the darkest of forests, while their inherent magic grants both wisdom and a measure of dexterity to their bearer.

Spiny_Cactus_Club_Arms.description: Bristling with razor-sharp spines and clad in thick, chitinous armor, the Spiny Cactus Club Arms are formidable plant-based appendages that enhance raw strength and provide natural protection, granting their wielder the sinister skills to both inflict bleeding wounds and tear through enemy armor with ease.

Supple_Bamboo_Whip_Arms.description: Supple Bamboo Whip Arms are slender, supple appendages that coil and uncoil with preternatural dexterity, granting unparalleled agility and reach, allowing their bearer to swing and climb with the grace and swiftness of a seasoned acrobat or a spider navigating the tallest of trees.

Blooming_Lotus_Petal_Arms.description: Emerging from the entity's shoulders are ethereal, glowing petal-like appendages, each one pulsating with vibrant hues of crimson and gold, exuding an aura of otherworldly charm and vitality that captivates all who behold them.
